scope: Offline finite-record direction audit of every normal unit-start baseline window in the 24 EXP-051 cells; no learner change or new analog conversion.
fixed_context: For each window freeze its actual pre-update stage2 state and all other stage1 coefficients; first inspect the actual joint stage1 Q22 update against the continuous digital-basis code objective, then score its exported Q1.10 coefficients on the same 120 observations.
direction_rule: A nonzero continuous directional term is locally favorable iff its sign is negative; report neutral separately. Exact finite continuous SSE change includes the quadratic term. Integer-code SSE uses the actual Q3 PWL, nearest-even final rounding and saturation.
evaluation: Report training and online-sine separately, per coordinate and joint; count exported no-change windows, favorable and adverse directional terms, exact continuous and integer-code SSE changes, and cross-tabulate first-coordinate direction with actual target/error correlation terms.
controls: Independent reconstruction of source baseline integer codes, coefficient transitions and offline selected-product attribution; source SHA256 checked before analysis.
limits: Same-record local frozen-state diagnostic, not a causal long-run intervention, online gradient, new calibration method, general curve theorem or chip result. Offline ideal code is forbidden from learner input.
